title: 第一卷 第25章 上门退婚第一卷 第26章 嫁人约定
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: “退婚？”
“我陪你去？”
林逸看着可怜兮兮的苏沐晴，心中一软。
李家那个纨绔，不做人事。
苏沐晴若是嫁给他，此生就完了！
这婚确实得退！
而且。
这是苏有福生前，定下的婚约，是为了拿到十亩灵田的聘礼。
嫁女求荣！
现在苏有福都死了，这婚约自然就不作数了。
“沐晴，我愿意陪你去！”
林逸看着苏沐晴，正色道。
“老林头，你就不怕因此得罪强大的李家？”
“毕竟，李家比我们苏家更加势大，家族人数足有十七口人，灵田超过两百亩！”
“你若是跟我去退婚，他们肯定会记恨你，以后会针对你的！”
苏沐晴咬着嘴唇，满脸认真，提醒林逸道。
“沐晴，就算得罪李家，我也不能眼看着，你往火坑里跳！”
“你在我微末时，就找我帮你种田，给了我丰厚酬劳，还提前预支灵石给我，还给我通风报信！”
“你有情，我有义！”
林逸义正言辞道。
其实他想的是，最起码，先不让苏沐晴，嫁给李家纨绔。
使得苏沐晴这辈子毁了，还便宜了李家。
只要苏沐晴没嫁人，她孤身一人，继承了苏有福的上百亩灵田。
将来，他若是有机会，娶了苏沐晴的话。
岂不是就能吃苏有福的绝户，得到这上百亩灵田？
苏有福，靠着吃老丈人的绝户发家。
善恶到头终有报。
最后反过来，要被他吃了绝户。
“老林头，这一步一旦走出，你可就是和李家成为死敌了！”
“退婚可不是小事！”
“这是当着所有人的面，打人家的脸，让对方颜面无存！”
“以后李家，在云梦城，都会沦为各大家族的笑柄，根本抬不起头来！”
“这样的大仇之下，李家肯定不会放过你的！”
“你真愿意这么做么？”
苏沐晴看向林逸的眼神里，有着提醒，担忧，还隐隐带着一抹期待。
在她跌入谷底，孤苦无依之际，她真希望有个人，能坚定不移和她站在一起，并肩而战。
这一次，也算是她对林逸的试探。
若是林逸退缩了，显然就不是值得她托付终生之人。
“沐晴，我肯定陪着你一起，去李家退婚！”
“至于得罪李家，那就得罪吧！”
林逸大义凛然道。
真男人，到了关键时刻，绝不能软下来！
content_en:
"Break off the engagement?"
"Shall I go with you?"
Lin Yi looked at the pitiful Su Muqing and felt soft in his heart.
That dude from the Li family doesn't do human affairs.
If Su Muqing marries him, her life will be over!
This marriage really needs to be called off!
and.
This was a marriage contract made by Su Youfu during his lifetime, in order to obtain the betrothal gift of ten acres of spiritual land.
Marry a daughter for glory!
Now that Su Youfu is dead, this engagement naturally doesn't count.
"Mu Qing, I am willing to accompany you!"
Lin Yi looked at Su Muqing and said seriously.
"Old Lintou, aren't you afraid of offending the powerful Li family?"
"After all, the Li family is more powerful than our Su family. There are seventeen members in the family, and the spiritual land exceeds two hundred acres!"
"If you go to break off the engagement with me, they will definitely hate you and target you in the future!"
Su Muqing bit her lip and reminded Lin Yidao with a serious face.
"Mu Qing, even if you offend the Li family, I can't watch you jump into the fire pit!"
"When I was still young, you asked me to help you farm, gave me a generous reward, advanced spiritual stones to me in advance, and even tipped me off!"
"You are affectionate and I am righteous!"
Lin Yiyi said righteously.
In fact, what he wanted to do was, at the very least, prevent Su Muqing from marrying a playboy from the Li family.
It ruined Su Muqing's life and gave the Li family an advantage.
As long as Su Muqing remained unmarried, she would be alone and inherit Su Youfu's hundreds of acres of spiritual land.
In the future, if he has a chance, he will marry Su Muqing.
Wouldn't it be possible to take advantage of Su Youfu's extinct family and get hundreds of acres of spiritual land?
Su Youfu made his fortune by eating his father-in-law's family.
Good and evil will be rewarded in the end.
In the end, he will turn around and be devoured by him.
"Old Lintou, once you take this step, you and the Li family will become mortal enemies!"
"Breaking off an engagement is no small matter!"
"This is to slap someone in the face in front of everyone and make them lose face!"
"From now on, the Li family in Yunmeng City will become the laughing stock of all the major families, and they will not be able to hold their heads up at all!"
"With such a big hatred, the Li family will definitely not let you go!"
"Are you really willing to do this?"
Su Muqing looked at Lin Yi with reminder, worry, and a hint of expectation in her eyes.
When she hit rock bottom and was helpless, she really hoped that there was someone who could stand with her unswervingly and fight side by side.
This time, it was her test of Lin Yi.
If Lin Yi flinches, it is obvious that he is not someone worthy of her trust for the rest of her life.
"Mu Qing, I will definitely accompany you to the Li family to break off the engagement!"
"As for offending the Li family, then offend them!"
Lin Yi said solemnly.
A real man must never soften at a critical moment!
